craft_notes: Sthāyin: freedom-joy (even without yoga). Close: groundlessness. Rejected: 'yoga-less' — killed; 'clan' flat — kept sung.

lines: By this mere known, known by all powers around,
śākinī-common he may be, sans yoga's ground.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anena jñātamātreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥ | śākinīkulasāmānyo bhaved yogaṃ vināpi hi

reads_against.argmap: By mere this known by all powers — śākinī-clan-common even without yoga.
c1_essence: Mere known by all powers; śākinī-common even without yoga.
